description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericAbstractDispatcher' which implements the 'LocalDispatcher' interface. It provides scheduling, registration, and transaction management functionalities for service dispatching within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericAbstractDispatcher
classes.description: An abstract class implementing service dispatching with scheduling and transaction management capabilities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dispatcher.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service with specified parameters, handling transaction suspension and resumption.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a rollback service for transaction management.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Registers a commit service for transaction management.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dispatcher.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Deregisters the dispatcher and removes it from cache.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific service.
